title: Allow stronger AI models on compatible weaker hardware
statement: Lamha MUST NOT prevent a user from selecting a stronger or higher-accuracy local AI model solely because estimated processing time is long or the hardware is weaker than recommended. After verifying that the model is technically compatible with the device, Lamha MUST show estimated processing time, memory use, storage use, power and thermal impact, and available acceleration. The user MUST be allowed to continue immediately, schedule the job, process selected folders only, or choose a lighter model. Lamha MAY block the model only for a hard technical incompatibility, including insufficient safe memory, insufficient storage, unsupported model operations, unsupported runtime/provider, invalid or corrupted model files, or unresolved licensing restrictions.
rationale: Amendment adds user override of model recommendations while preserving hard compatibility gates.
source_text: Allow stronger AI models on compatible weaker hardware
acceptance_criteria: Given a weaker laptop, when a stronger compatible model is listed, then it remains selectable and estimated duration/resource impact are shown; long duration alone never creates a hard block; insufficient safe memory, insufficient storage, unsupported operations, invalid model files, and licensing restrictions create hard blocks with exact reasons; user override, scheduling, selected-folder scope, pause/resume, and no silent substitution are supported; quantized variants are distinct; model/version/checksum/licence provenance is preserved; model changes invalidate affected derived AI results.
verification_method: Run the AI model override amendment fixtures: compatibility listing, weak-hardware offer, slow-selectable, estimate display, user override, scheduling, selected folders, pause/resume, hard-block reasons, no silent substitution, quantized identity, provenance, and invalidation checks.
risk_links: Model compatibility and resource estimation risk
phase_mapping_rationale: Amendment belongs to Local AI worker in I10 because model selection, compatibility, and user override execute in the local AI pipeline.
review_notes: Pass C amendment: stronger compatible models remain user-selectable; hard technical incompatibility is the only block.
